_about: MLX90640 example input data and expected output from Melexis N.V., as adapted in the mlx9064x Rust crate (mlx9064x-test-data/src/mlx90640_example_data.rs, https://github.com/paxswill/mlx9064x-rs, fetched 2026-09-28). The crate states the data comes from the 'Input data' sheet of the Melexis example spreadsheet. Used by test_frame_reader.py as the golden vector for frame_reader.py's port of the Melexis compensation. Converted from that Rust source to JSON for this repository, and the _units note added; the full licence text is in LICENSE-APACHE-2.0 next to this file.

_units: Word arrays are 16-bit values as read from the sensor. temperatures are degC after both subpages, emissivity 1.0 (reflected temperature then cancels). alpha_pixels, kta_pixels, kv_pixels are the per-pixel coefficients as reals; offset_pixels are integers.
